quote: The only true wisdom is in knowing you know nothing.
author: Socrates
quote_cn: 我唯一知道的就是我一无所知。

quote: We are what we repeatedly do. Excellence, then, is not an act, but a habit.
author: Aristotle
quote_cn: 我们日复一日做的事情决定了我们。因此，卓越不是一种行为，而是一种习惯。

quote: He who has a why to live can bear almost any how.
author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quote_cn: 知道为什么而活的人，便能忍受任何生存之苦。

quote: You have power over your mind - not outside events. Realize this, and you will find strength.
author: Marcus Aurelius
quote_cn: 你对自己的内心拥有掌控权，而不是外在事件。领会这一点，你就会获得力量。

quote: I think, therefore I am.
author: René Descartes
quote_cn: 我思故我在。

quote: It does not matter how slowly you go as long as you do not stop.
author: Confucius
quote_cn: 不怕慢，只怕站；行而不辍，未来可期。

quote: A journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step.
author: Lao Tzu
quote_cn: 千里之行，始于足下。

quote: Happiness is not an ideal of reason, but of imagination.
author: Immanuel Kant
quote_cn: 幸福不是理性的理想，而是想象力的产物。

quote: Man is condemned to be free; because once thrown into the world, he is responsible for everything he does.
author: Jean-Paul Sartre
quote_cn: 人注定是自由的；因为一旦被抛入这个世界，他就对自己的所作所为负全责。

quote: In the depth of winter, I finally learned that within me there lay an invincible summer.
author: Albert Camus
quote_cn: 在寒冬的最深处，我终于领悟到，在我的内心深处有一处不可战胜的盛夏。

quote: Peace is not the absence of war, it is a virtue, a state of mind, a disposition for benevolence, confidence, justice.
author: Baruch Spinoza
quote_cn: 和平不是没有战争，而是一种美德，一种心灵状态，一种仁爱、信任与正义的倾向。

quote: Talent hits a target no one else can hit; Genius hits a target no one else can see.
author: Arthur Schopenhauer
quote_cn: 才能击中无人能击中的目标，而天才击中无人能看到的目标。

quote: Wealth consists not in having great possessions, but in having few wants.
author: Epictetus
quote_cn: 富足不在于拥有巨额财富，而在于欲望极少。

quote: Luck is what happens when preparation meets opportunity.
author: Seneca
quote_cn: 所谓的幸运，就是当充分的准备遇到了机遇。

quote: The unexamined life is not worth living.
author: Socrates
quote_cn: 未经审视的人生不值得度过。

quote: Knowing yourself is the beginning of all wisdom.
author: Aristotle
quote_cn: 认识自己是一切智慧的开端。

quote: The measure of a man is what he does with power.
author: Plato
quote_cn: 衡量一个人的最终标准，是看他在拥有权力时会做什么。

quote: To live is to suffer, to survive is to find some meaning in the suffering.
author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quote_cn: 活着就是受苦，生存就是要在痛苦中寻找某种意义。

quote: Imagination is more important than knowledge. For knowledge is limited, whereas imagination embraces the entire world.
author: Albert Einstein
quote_cn: 想象力比知识更重要。因为知识是有限的，而想象力概括着世界上的一切。

quote: If I have seen further it is by standing on the shoulders of Giants.
author: Isaac Newton
quote_cn: 如果我看得更远，那是因为我站在巨人的肩膀上。

quote: Nothing in life is to be feared, it is only to be understood. Now is the time to understand more, so that we may fear less.
author: Marie Curie
quote_cn: 生活中没有什么可怕的，只有需要去理解的。现在是去深入理解的时候，这样我们才能少一些畏惧。

quote: The present is theirs; the future, for which I really worked, is mine.
author: Nikola Tesla
quote_cn: 现在是他们的；而我真正为之付出的未来，是我的。

quote: And yet it moves.
author: Galileo Galilei
quote_cn: 可是，地球依然在转动。

quote: The first principle is that you must not fool yourself and you are the easiest person to fool.
author: Richard Feynman
quote_cn: 首要原则是你绝对不能欺骗自己，而你自己恰恰是最容易被欺骗的人。

quote: Intelligence is the ability to adapt to change.
author: Stephen Hawking
quote_cn: 智慧就是适应变化的能力。

quote: Somewhere, something incredible is waiting to be known.
author: Carl Sagan
quote_cn: 在某个未知的角落，某种不可思议的事物正等待着被揭晓。

quote: Sometimes it is the people no one imagines anything of who do the things that no one can imagine.
author: Alan Turing
quote_cn: 有时，正是那些不被任何人看好的人，成就了常人无法想象的奇迹。

quote: That brain of mine is something more than merely mortal; as time will show.
author: Ada Lovelace
quote_cn: 正如时间会证明的那样，我拥有的大脑绝非仅仅属于凡人。

quote: It is not the strongest of the species that survives, nor the most intelligent, but the one most responsive to change.
author: Charles Darwin
quote_cn: 能存活下来的物种，既不是最强壮的，也不是最聪明的，而是最能适应变化的。

quote: An expert is a person who has made all the mistakes that can be made in a very narrow field.
author: Niels Bohr
quote_cn: 专家就是在极其狭窄的领域里犯过所有可能错误的人。

quote: The most dangerous phrase in the language is, 'We've always done it this way.'
author: Grace Hopper
quote_cn: 语言中最危险的一句话就是：'我们向来都是这么做的。'

quote: Innovation distinguishes between a leader and a follower.
author: Steve Jobs
quote_cn: 创新是区分领袖与追随者的分水岭。

quote: We need diversity of thought in the world to face the new challenges.
author: Tim Berners-Lee
quote_cn: 面对新世界的挑战，我们需要思想的多样性。

quote: Look deep into nature, and then you will understand everything better.
author: Albert Einstein
quote_cn: 深入观察大自然，你就会对世间万物理解得更加深刻。

quote: I seem to have been only like a boy playing on the seashore, finding a smoother pebble or prettier shell, whilst the great ocean of truth lay undiscovered before me.
author: Isaac Newton
quote_cn: 我似乎只是一个在海边玩耍的孩子，偶尔捡到一颗更光滑的石子或更美丽的贝壳，而在我面前，真理的浩瀚海洋仍未被探知。

quote: Science is a way of thinking much more than it is a body of knowledge.
author: Carl Sagan
quote_cn: 科学是一种思维方式，远不仅是一套现成的知识体系。

quote: To be, or not to be, that is the question.
author: William Shakespeare
quote_cn: 生存还是毁灭，这是一个值得考虑的问题。

quote: The secret of getting ahead is getting started.
author: Mark Twain
quote_cn: 取得成功的秘诀在于立即开始行动。

quote: Be yourself; everyone else is already taken.
author: Oscar Wilde
quote_cn: 做你自己，因为其他人都有人做了。

quote: In a time of deceit telling the truth is a revolutionary act.
author: George Orwell
quote_cn: 在充斥谎言的时代，说出真相就是一场革命行动。

quote: Lock up your libraries if you like; but there is no gate, no lock, no bolt that you can set upon the freedom of my mind.
author: Virginia Woolf
quote_cn: 如果愿意，尽可以把你们的图书馆锁上；但没有任何门、没有锁、没有任何门闩可以禁锢我思想的自由。

quote: Everyone thinks of changing the world, but no one thinks of changing himself.
author: Leo Tolstoy
quote_cn: 人人都想改变世界，却罕有人想改变自己。

quote: To live without hope is to cease to live.
author: Fyodor Dostoevsky
quote_cn: 没有希望地活着，就是放弃活着。

quote: There is no charm equal to tenderness of heart.
author: Jane Austen
quote_cn: 没有什么魅力能比得上一颗温柔的心。

quote: What matters in life is not what happens to you, but what you remember and how you remember it.
author: Gabriel García Márquez
quote_cn: 生活不是我们活过的日子，而是我们记住的日子，以及我们如何记住它们。
author_cn: 加夫列尔·加西亚·马尔克斯

quote: There is no greater agony than bearing an untold story inside you.
author: Maya Angelou
quote_cn: 世上最巨大的痛苦，莫过于心中藏着一个未曾诉说的故事。

quote: Hope is the thing with feathers that perches in the soul.
author: Emily Dickinson
quote_cn: 希望是个长着羽毛的东西，栖息在灵魂深处。

quote: Even the darkest night will end and the sun will rise.
author: Victor Hugo
quote_cn: 即使是最黑的夜也会终结，太阳终将升起。

quote: Courage is grace under pressure.
author: Ernest Hemingway
quote_cn: 勇气，就是在重压之下的优雅风度。

quote: A book must be the axe for the frozen sea within us.
author: Franz Kafka
quote_cn: 一本好书，必须是破开我们心中冰封之海的利斧。

quote: All the world's a stage, and all the men and women merely players.
author: William Shakespeare
quote_cn: 世界是一个舞台，所有的男男女女不过是一些演员。

quote: The two most important days in your life are the day you are born and the day you find out why.
author: Mark Twain
quote_cn: 人一生中最重要的两天：一天是你出生的那天，另一天是你明白自己为何而生的那天。

quote: We are all in the gutter, but some of us are looking at the stars.
author: Oscar Wilde
quote_cn: 我们都生活在阴沟里，但仍有人在仰望星空。

quote: Success is not final, failure is not fatal: it is the courage to continue that counts.
author: Winston Churchill
quote_cn: 成功不是终点，失败也非末日：最重要的是继续前行的勇气。

quote: It always seems impossible until it's done.
author: Nelson Mandela
quote_cn: 在事情完成之前，它总是看似绝无可能。

quote: Darkness cannot drive out darkness; only light can do that. Hate cannot drive out hate; only love can do that.
author: Martin Luther King Jr.
quote_cn: 黑暗无法驱散黑暗，只有光芒能做到；仇恨无法消除仇恨，唯有仁爱能化解。

quote: Nearly all men can stand adversity, but if you want to test a man's character, give him power.
author: Abraham Lincoln
quote_cn: 几乎所有人都能经受逆境的考验，但如果你想测试一个人的品格，请给他权力。

quote: Be the change that you wish to see in the world.
author: Mahatma Gandhi
quote_cn: 欲变世界，先变其身；成为你想在世间看到的改变。

quote: The future belongs to those who believe in the beauty of their dreams.
author: Eleanor Roosevelt
quote_cn: 未来属于那些深信自己梦想之美好的人。

quote: Do what you can, with what you have, where you are.
author: Theodore Roosevelt
quote_cn: 用你现有的条件，尽你最大的努力，立足于当下。

quote: In the midst of chaos, there is also opportunity.
author: Sun Tzu
quote_cn: 在混乱纷扰之中，亦孕育着无限转机。

quote: The only thing we have to fear is fear itself.
author: Franklin D. Roosevelt
quote_cn: 我们唯一需要恐惧的，就是恐惧本身。

quote: One child, one teacher, one book, one pen can change the world.
author: Malala Yousafzai
quote_cn: 一个孩子、一名教师、一本书、一支笔，就可以改变世界。

quote: Every great dream begins with a dreamer. Always remember, you have within you the strength, the patience, and the passion to reach for the stars to change the world.
author: Harriet Tubman
quote_cn: 每一个伟大的梦想都始于梦想家。请始终牢记，你心中拥有改变世界所需的力量、耐心与热情。

quote: Ask not what your country can do for you - ask what you can do for your country.
author: John F. Kennedy
quote_cn: 不要问你的国家能为你做什么，问你能为你的国家做什么。

quote: There is nothing impossible to him who will try.
author: Alexander the Great
quote_cn: 凡勇敢尝试之人，世间绝无不可逾越之险境。

quote: If you're going through hell, keep going.
author: Winston Churchill
quote_cn: 如果你正在穿过地狱，请继续走下去，绝不退缩。

quote: A leader is a dealer in hope.
author: Napoleon Bonaparte
quote_cn: 领袖，就是兜售希望的人。

quote: I have a dream that one day this nation will rise up and live out the true meaning of its creed.
author: Martin Luther King Jr.
quote_cn: 我有一个梦想，深信这片土地终将崛起，真正实践其立国信条的真谛。

quote: No one can make you feel inferior without your consent.
author: Eleanor Roosevelt
quote_cn: 未经你的准许，没有任何人能让你感到自卑。

quote: Do not go where the path may lead, go instead where there is no path and leave a trail.
author: Ralph Waldo Emerson
quote_cn: 不要沿着现成的小径走，去往没有路的地方，留下一串属于自己的足迹。

quote: Go confidently in the direction of your dreams. Live the life you have imagined.
author: Henry David Thoreau
quote_cn: 满怀信心地奔向梦想的方向，去过你曾经憧憬的生活。

quote: The best and most beautiful things in the world cannot be seen or even touched - they must be felt with the heart.
author: Helen Keller
quote_cn: 世上最美好、最珍贵的事物，无法用眼睛看到甚至无法触摸，必须用心去感受。

quote: Tell me and I forget. Teach me and I remember. Involve me and I learn.
author: Benjamin Franklin
quote_cn: 告诉我，我会忘记；教给我，我会记住；让我参与其中，我才会真正领悟。

quote: Yesterday I was clever, so I wanted to change the world. Today I am wise, so I am changing myself.
author: Rumi
quote_cn: 昨天我很聪明，所以我想改变世界；今天我很明智，所以我正在改变自己。

quote: Whoever is happy will make others happy too.
author: Anne Frank
quote_cn: 凡是快乐的人，也必将把快乐传递给身边的每一个人。

quote: When we are no longer able to change a situation, we are challenged to change ourselves.
author: Viktor Frankl
quote_cn: 当我们无法改变周围境遇时，我们便面临着改变自我的挑战。

quote: Peace comes from within. Do not seek it without.
author: Buddha
quote_cn: 宁静源自内心，切莫向外盲目求索。

quote: The good life is one inspired by love and guided by knowledge.
author: Bertrand Russell
quote_cn: 美好的人生是由爱所激励、由知识所引导的人生。

quote: You are never too old to set another goal or to dream a new dream.
author: C.S. Lewis
quote_cn: 你永远不会因为年龄太大而无法设立新目标，或去追寻新的梦想。

quote: To be yourself in a world that is constantly trying to make you something else is the greatest accomplishment.
author: Ralph Waldo Emerson
quote_cn: 在一个不断试图将你塑造成其他模样的世界里，坚持做真实的自己就是最伟大的成就。

quote: An investment in knowledge pays the best interest.
author: Benjamin Franklin
quote_cn: 对知识的投资总能带来丰厚回报。

quote: Simplicity is the ultimate sophistication.
author: Clare Boothe Luce
quote_cn: 至繁归于至简，简单是最高级的精致。

quote: The greatest glory in living lies not in never falling, but in rising every time we fall.
author: Nelson Mandela
quote_cn: 生命中最伟大的光荣，不在于永不跌倒，而在于每次跌倒后都能重新站起。

quote: In three words I can sum up everything I've learned about life: it goes on.
author: Robert Frost
quote_cn: 用三个词我可以总结我所学到的人生一切：生活仍在继续。

quote: Learning never exhausts the mind.
author: Leonardo da Vinci
quote_cn: 学习永远不会耗尽心智。

quote: Every child is an artist. The problem is how to remain an artist once we grow up.
author: Pablo Picasso
quote_cn: 每个孩子都是天生的艺术家。难题在于长大后如何保持那份艺术之心。

quote: I dream my painting and I paint my dream.
author: Vincent van Gogh
quote_cn: 我梦见我的画，然后我画出我的梦。

quote: The greater danger for most of us lies not in setting our aim too high and falling short; but in setting our aim too low, and achieving our mark.
author: Michelangelo
quote_cn: 对大多数人而言，最大的危险不是目标定得太高而未能达到，而是目标定得太低却轻松达成。

quote: Have no fear of perfection - you'll never reach it.
author: Salvador Dalí
quote_cn: 不要害怕追求完美——因为你永远无法达到它。

quote: I perhaps owe having become a painter to flowers.
author: Claude Monet
quote_cn: 也许正是盛开的花朵，让我成为了画家。

quote: To create one's own world in any of the arts takes courage.
author: Georgia O'Keeffe
quote_cn: 在任何艺术领域创造属于自己的世界，都需要非凡的勇气。

quote: Creativity takes courage.
author: Henri Matisse
quote_cn: 创造力需要勇气。

quote: At the end of the day, we can endure much more than we think we can.
author: Frida Kahlo
quote_cn: 到头来，我们能够承受的坚韧，远超我们自己的想象。

quote: Art is what you can get away with.
author: Andy Warhol
quote_cn: 艺术，就是你能让人信以为真的东西。

quote: Art washes away from the soul the dust of everyday life.
author: Pablo Picasso
quote_cn: 艺术能涤除日常琐碎在灵魂上积聚的尘埃。

quote: If you hear a voice within you say 'you cannot paint,' then by all means paint, and that voice will be silenced.
author: Vincent van Gogh
quote_cn: 如果你内心深处听到一个声音说'你不会画画'，那么请拿起画笔尽情去画，那个声音自然会归于沉寂。

quote: Simplicity is the ultimate sophistication.
author: Leonardo da Vinci
quote_cn: 大道至简，简单是终极的精微深邃。

quote: Don't think about making art, just get it done. Let everyone else decide if it's good or bad, whether they love it or hate it. While they are deciding, make even more art.
author: Andy Warhol
quote_cn: 不要瞻前顾后地想着创作艺术，只管去创作。让世界去评判它是好是坏，喜不喜欢。在他们争论不休时，继续创作更多的艺术。

quote: I found I could say things with color and shapes that I couldn't say any other way - things I had no words for.
author: Georgia O'Keeffe
quote_cn: 我发现我能用色彩和线条说出许多无法言说的东西——那些语言无能为力表达的情感。
